properties.description: Keep the Repositories view synchronized with external filesystem changes without reloading the page. Subscribe through the owning service, update additions/deletions/renames and modified files, retain selection/expansion/scroll and unsaved editor drafts, and dispose subscriptions when their scope is no longer used. Coalesce bursts so large unfiltered repositories remain responsive; do not introduce hidden-folder filters. Verify changes made outside the app and stale selected paths.
properties.title: Subscribe Repositories to filesystem changes
